name: zoom-notetaker
title: Zoom notetaker
summary: Joins a Zoom meeting in a headless browser, records it, and writes up the notes.
blurb: Paste a Zoom link and get minutes back — with no meeting-bot service in the loop. One tool drives a local headless Chromium into the call through Zoom's web client, records the meeting's audio in the page, and transcribes it with a speech-to-text model you configure entirely by env vars: any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint (the OpenAI API by default, a local faster-whisper server if you point STT_URL at one) or a local command like whisper-cli via STT_COMMAND. A captions mode reads Zoom's own live captions instead, needing no STT at all. The same fixed-heading prompt as meeting-notes turns the transcript into a summary, decisions, action items and open questions — and the flow branches to a plain-spoken failure end when the browser could not get in, nothing made a sound, or the transcriber failed, rather than summarizing a meeting it never heard.

requires.hint: the tool speaks the DevTools protocol over Node's built-in WebSocket
the same names attend_meeting.mjs searches; CHROME_BIN=/path/to/chrome pins another
the notes step, and transcription unless STT_URL or STT_COMMAND points elsewhere
